ranked.headline: Deep generative models separate biological variation in single-cell and spatial omics
ranked.summary: Recent work pairs disentangled latent models with causal, spatial and foundation-model designs to isolate biological factors in single-cell data.

ranked.headline: Software refines microbiome profiling from 16S references to metagenome annotation
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications extend reference curation, annotation, differential abundance, and functional recovery tools for microbiome analysis.

ranked.headline: Generative models design molecules against explicit objectives and realism checks
ranked.summary: Benchmarks against confirmed actives and synthesis-aware scoring now test whether generated molecules are realistic, not merely produced.

ranked.headline: Single-cell trajectories are modeled for differential expression and regulatory inference
ranked.summary: Single-cell trajectory data now support pseudotime-aware differential expression, regulatory network inference, and pathway activity scoring.

ranked.headline: Long-read methods expand detection of structural, mitochondrial and complex variation
ranked.summary: Long-read sequencing now enables local assembly, target-free allele reconstruction, and methylation-aware phasing across diverse variant classes.

ranked.headline: Multimodal spatial and single-cell atlases map healthy and developing human tissues
ranked.summary: Spatial, multi-omic and temporal axes are now being combined within single tissue or developmental frameworks rather than analyzed as isolated snapshots.

ranked.headline: Inferring regulatory activity from splicing, chromatin, and cfDNA data
ranked.summary: Regulatory activity is now inferred from splicing assays, cell-free DNA fragmentation, and multi-tissue RNA-seq at population and cross-species scale.

ranked.headline: Graph and Transformer representations advance molecular generation and property prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints extend graph and Transformer molecular encoders to generation, imbalanced regression and ligand-protein interaction prediction.

ranked.headline: SE(3) diffusion models extend to antibody design, docking, and protein dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a journal article apply SE(3)-equivariant diffusion to antibody, ligand, and conformational-ensemble tasks.

ranked.headline: LLM frameworks integrate biological knowledge and multimodal data for prediction tasks
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test LLMs on rare disease, imaging, single-cell, and metabolomic data, asking whether biological context improves prediction.

ranked.headline: Label-efficient models segment nuclei, ultrastructure and cells in microscopy images
ranked.summary: Recent preprints adapt self-supervised, self-training and fine-tuned segmentation to histology, electron and multiplexed microscopy modalities.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link feedback and network topology to cell state stability and polarity
ranked.summary: Quantitative models now test how feedback, canalization, and crowding set cell-state stability across epithelial, stem, and cancer systems.

ranked.headline: Deep models for DNA and RNA sequence-to-function prediction and benchmarking
ranked.summary: Large benchmarks and multimodal training now test nucleotide foundation models across fitness, structure, regulation and base-editing tasks.

ranked.headline: Machine learning prioritizes antibacterial peptides and cyanine dyes for testing
ranked.summary: Interpretable, deep, and LLM-based models are now applied to antibacterial candidates before wet-lab validation across several compound classes.

ranked.headline: Graph-based multimodal learning predicts protein function and drug-target interactions
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair graph neural networks with sequence, text, or structure features for biomolecular association prediction.

ranked.headline: Web-accessible tools now packaging RNA, microbial genomics, and amplicon analyses
ranked.summary: Recent releases package RNA structure annotation, pan-genome, amplicon, and probe design analyses into accessible interfaces.

ranked.headline: Deep learning models infer genotype and subtype from histopathology and omics data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and software tools apply deep and network-based learning to histopathology, tumor genotypes, and single-cell RNA-seq data.

ranked.headline: Neural models learn directly from raw sequencing and genomic data
ranked.summary: Preprints and one published study apply learned models directly to raw or sequence-level biological data, bypassing intermediate processing steps.

ranked.headline: Automated pipelines recover viral genomes and filter artifacts from large sequence sets
ranked.summary: Large public and metagenomic sequence collections call for scalable tools that process many genomes and reads without manual curation.

ranked.headline: Physics-informed and geometry-constrained models target biomolecular conformations
ranked.summary: Recent preprints couple physics-based simulation and geometry constraints to predict conformational states across kinases, RNA-binding domains, and DNA.

ranked.headline: Computational tools map sequence variation to protein folding and function effects
ranked.summary: Recent preprints benchmark and deploy variant-effect, folding-energy, and sequence-design tools across bacterial genomes and protein selection datasets.

ranked.headline: Constrained models and Bayesian networks are tested for inference from biological data
ranked.summary: Preprints and a 2025 benchmark test how dependency structure and constraints can be recovered from proportional, microbiome, and lipidomics data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models link resource supply, vector traits, and resistance to persistence
ranked.summary: Dengue infects nearly 390 million people annually, and recent models treat supply, traits, and dosing as controllable persistence inputs.

ranked.headline: Simulation-ready preparation of predicted and sampled biomolecular structures for MD
ranked.summary: Predicted and cofolded structures increasingly require conversion into simulation-ready systems and trajectory-level analysis before use.

ranked.headline: Linking neuronal metabolism, callosal genetics, and imaging pipelines to brain disease
ranked.summary: Recent work adds imaging preprocessing tools, neuron-level metabolic models, and callosal genetics to disease-linked studies of brain architecture.

ranked.headline: Local rules and connectivity set emergent dynamics in neural and tissue systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study tie local microscopic rules to emergent network, tissue, and condensate dynamics.

ranked.headline: Optimized non-equispaced sampling improves detection of biological rhythms
ranked.summary: A November 2025 publication formalizes sampling-schedule optimization for rhythm detection, alongside aging-focused temporal preprints.

ranked.headline: Network, Boolean and spatial models prioritize cancer therapeutic targets
ranked.summary: Calibrated spatial models, uncertainty-aware synergy prediction and genetic intervention sets are now used to rank therapeutic targets and combinations.

ranked.headline: MD simulations resolve conformational switching in ezrin, σ2R homodimers, and NLRP3
ranked.summary: Adaptive sampling, kinetic state modeling, and ML-assisted analysis are now combined with atomistic MD to dissect activation mechanisms.

ranked.headline: Text mining and reanalysis tools turn public biomedical data into queryable networks
ranked.summary: Heterogeneous public literature and transcriptomic archives are now being converted into structured, queryable resources by deployable software tools.

ranked.headline: MD simulations map allosteric routes in nucleosome and RNA polymerase II complexes
ranked.summary: Molecular dynamics now resolves allosteric routes across nucleic acid and nucleic acid-protein assemblies, from DSIF-bound Pol II to CENP-A nucleosomes.

ranked.headline: Statistically consistent phylogenetic methods for gene, species, and network trees
ranked.summary: Recent methods address gene tree error, network coalescent reconstruction, and confidence at two-million-genome SARS-CoV-2 scale.

ranked.headline: Optimal transport geometry quantifies biological shape from skulls to proteins
ranked.summary: Recent preprints apply metric geometry and Wasserstein-based kernels to compare biological shapes across morphology and protein structure.

ranked.headline: Open-source tools convert lipidomics, GNPS, and MRS data into interpretable outputs
ranked.summary: Recent preprints package lipidomics, GNPS molecular networking, and MRS analyses as accessible open-source software for interpretation.

ranked.headline: Inferring parameters and interaction structure of biological dynamical models from data
ranked.summary: Specialized inference schemes now target specific model structures, from multi-scale dynamics to compositional microbial abundance data.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic models of immunity waning, reinfection, and staged viral processes
ranked.summary: Recent preprints model delayed immunity build-up, waning, and reinfection using explicit age-structured and staged formulations.
